title: Target dream
content: I had a dream that my husband, adult daughter and I had gone to Lexington, Kentucky to shop at a big mall that had a Target. It was a huge Target with multiple entrances but all outside. (Please note, I haven’t been to Lexington in years, and I don’t think this represents an actual mall there.) I became separated from my husband and daughter, but somehow I knew they were waiting in the car for me. However, it was pitch black outside and I couldn’t reach them. I ended up back in Target and I stood in line to purchase something. The guy behind me bumped into me and lingered. I started to tell him gently to stop, then I became outraged and screamed at him before storming off. At some point I collapsed and woke up in urgent care in the mall. The physician was the guy who had bumped into me before, and he looked exactly like a former coworker. He said I had a heart murmur and he had suspected that while standing behind me (psychic?), which was why he had gotten so close to me. I kept trying to reach my daughter to let her know where I was, but I couldn’t find her in my contacts, and when I went to manually input her number, I couldn’t find the phone or messaging app. When I woke up, I remembered my Fitbit has an irregular heartbeat (a fib) detector, so I decided to turn that on in case the dream was trying to tell me something. In the meantime, I found out today that my dad’s doctor detected a heart murmur at his last appointment.
